Fetch ontology statistics

fetch_ontology_stats.Rd

Fetch ontology statistics

Usage

fetch_ontology_stats()

Value

A named list with fields: total_entities, total_level1– total_level4, total_relations, total_mappings, categories.

Examples

# \donttest{
fetch_ontology_stats()
#> Warning: Selecting ‘env’ backend. Secrets are stored in environment variables
